data.summary: The pod eval-svc-bdf548d94-zkxr2 took 30.0 s to become Ready, breaching the 10.0 s SLO threshold. The delay was caused by a slow image pull, which took 28.724 s for a relatively small image of 53,328,919 bytes due to a low throughput of 1.9 MB/s.

findings.statement: The total pod startup time was 30.0 s, exceeding the SLO threshold of 10.0 s.
The image pull phase took 28.724 s to download 53,328,919 bytes (approx 53 MB).
The transfer throughput during the image pull was low at 1,856,598 bytes/s (approx 1.9 MB/s).

recommendations.rationale: The throughput of 1.9 MB/s was below the expected threshold of 5 MB/s, causing the image pull to consume 28.724 s of the startup duration.
